events.significance: A foundational primary text in the intellectual history of artificial intelligence.

events.title: Dartmouth Artificial Intelligence Proposal
events.summary: John McCarthy, Marvin Minsky, Nathaniel Rochester and Claude Shannon authored the proposal for the Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence, dated August 31, 1955.
events.significance: The proposal explicitly used the term artificial intelligence for the planned 1956 research project and survives as a documentary record of the field's early formation.

verification.note: Authors, date and archival history verified through the AI Magazine reproduction of the original proposal.

events.summary: Vaswani and colleagues introduced the Transformer architecture in Attention Is All You Need, proposing a sequence-transduction architecture based on attention mechanisms without recurrence or convolutions.
events.significance: The Transformer became a central architecture in subsequent language-model and generative-AI development.
